name: NVIDIA DeepStream
description: Add NVIDIA DeepStream to a devcontainer, built from source

dsVersion.description: DeepStream version. Use latest to build NVIDIA's current main branch; legacy support is provided for 6.3–8.0 and 9.x versions use NVIDIA's GitHub monorepo build.

platform.description: Target platform. sbsa is supported only for DeepStream 9.x and newer.
